result.summary: The team agreed on a staged rollout for v2.3: 10% of users on Friday, full rollout after QA sign-off on Monday. Marco will merge the rate-limiting fix by Wednesday, draft the rollback runbook and update help center articles by Thursday. Dana will finish onboarding email copy by Thursday. Sam will write the QA test plan by tomorrow. Priya will send the staged-rollout plan to marketing today. Dana will ask legal about data-retention text review.

tasks.title: Merge rate-limiting fix
tasks.rationale: Required for release candidate; without it QA cannot start full testing and launch is blocked.

tasks.title: Finish onboarding email copy
tasks.rationale: Needed for user onboarding communication at launch.

tasks.title: Write QA test plan
tasks.rationale: QA cannot begin testing without a plan; due tomorrow to allow testing to start Thursday.

tasks.title: Update help center articles for the new settings page
tasks.rationale: Supports user-facing changes but does not block the staged rollout.

tasks.title: Draft rollback runbook
tasks.rationale: Required to mitigate risk if issues arise during staged rollout.

tasks.title: Send staged-rollout plan to marketing
tasks.rationale: Marketing needs the plan to coordinate communications with the engineering rollout.

decisions: Keep public Friday launch announcement but ship to 10% of users on Friday and go to 100% after QA sign-off.
Marco owns the help center articles update.
Marco will draft the rollback runbook by Thursday.
Priya will send the staged-rollout plan to marketing by end of day.
open_questions: Whether legal needs to review the new data-retention text (Dana to ask legal today).

conflicts.description: QA requires three full days for testing but only had two days (Thursday and Friday) before the announced Friday launch.
conflicts.resolution: Resolved by staged rollout: 10% launch on Friday, full launch after QA sign-off on Monday.
